qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Linde and STILL forklift dealer networks offer service switching costs, but group capital returns are permanently diluted by capital-intensive warehouse automation (Dematic) project volatility and rising low-cost Chinese competition.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% across cycle, REJECT). Long-term ROCE/ROIC consistently hovers in the 7-9% range (7.7% in 2025, 8.7% in 2024), failing the Munger 12% threshold due to Dematic project margin volatility and intensifying low-cost Chinese forklift competition.
qualitative.evidence: KION Group's 10-year average ROCE is ~7-8%, well below the cost of capital. The 2016 debt-financed acquisition of Dematic added goodwill and volatile fixed-price contract risks, while Chinese manufacturers (Hangcha, Heli) pressure new forklift pricing.
